title: Paarai
desc: Durai Raj, a lorry driver, has only one friend, Jayaram. However, when his friend dies, Durai Raj strives to support his family.

title: Idhu Namma Bhoomi
desc: Gopi loves Nalini, but her father, Rathnavel, opposes their marriage due to an old feud with Gopi's father, Jaganathan. Determined to bring peace, Gopi resolves to reunite the two estranged families.

title: Gounder Vettu Mappillai
desc: A man visits his sister and her family to invite them to his wedding. However, things take a turn when he realises his niece has fallen for him.

title: En Uyir Thozhan
desc: Chittu finds herself abandoned and alone until Dharma steps in to help, but his deep loyalty to politics begins to strain the fragile peace they build.

title: Thirumoorthy
desc: Murthy, a truck driver, fights against a corrupt politician, Sigamani, and contests in the elections against one of his aides. However, things take a turn when he becomes a murder suspect.
